key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings associated with acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide content in Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings provide a process-development starting point: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Used a two-level full factorial design reported as 24 experimental runs.
Measured coating properties and applied ANOVA to quantify spray-parameter contributions.
Used Pareto charts to assess parameter interaction effects.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating-response measurements for each experimental run but provides no numerical property values or statistical results.
watch_item: Validate these settings against application-specific quality limits before transferring them to other equipment or coating–substrate systems.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
